identity.name: ChurchKey
identity.notes: The restaurant-controlled homepage and all three currently linked menu PDFs identify ChurchKey at 1337 14th Street NW. The restaurant-linked Mallard & ChurchKey Toast storefront gives the same address and phone. No similarly named business or out-of-location menu was merged.

sources.excerpt: The official ChurchKey homepage identifies the 14th Street craft-beer bar, gives 1337 14th Street NW, Washington, DC 20005 and phone (202) 567-2576, and links the current food, drafts and drinks, bottled beer and whiskey, and Toast menus.

The current restaurant-linked CKDC food PDF names 17 products across flatbreads, snacks and smalls, sandwiches and bigs, including ingredient-style descriptions and a general raw-food warning, but no allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

The current Summer ChurchKey drafts and drinks PDF has a dedicated Alcohol Free section with 12 products. The remainder of the surface is alcoholic and out of POC scope. No allergen matrix or cross-contact statement appears.

The current restaurant-linked bottled beers and whiskeys PDF has a dedicated Non-Alcoholic page with 13 products. Its alcoholic beer and whiskey inventory is out of POC scope. The PDF provides no allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

The homepage-linked Mallard & ChurchKey Toast storefront identifies 1337 14th St NW and exposes 13 CK Food products plus 12 non-alcoholic retail products among an otherwise alcohol-only retail catalog. It provides menu descriptions but no allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure.

Targeted searches for ChurchKey and churchkeydc.com with allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and menu terms surfaced the restaurant's current and historical menu PDFs and third-party historical gluten-free claims, but no current restaurant-issued allergen matrix, comprehensive ingredient guide, or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: Restaurant-issued and restaurant-linked-vendor surfaces consistently resolve to ChurchKey/Mallard & ChurchKey at 1337 14th Street NW, Washington, DC 20005.

The frozen 63-row projection contains 38 alcohol-only beer products and 12 menu headings/modifier artifacts. The current POC boundary instead contains 18 food products and 14 consolidated non-alcoholic beverages.

The complete 32-product boundary is the union of the live food PDF, two official non-alcoholic PDF sections, and the linked Toast food and non-alcoholic retail inventory. Repeated products are consolidated while retaining every current presentation source.

Linked Toast has recipe text that differs from the restaurant PDF for Bee Sting and carries a catfish description under Heirloom Tomato BLT. Direct positives from both sources are retained conservatively; neither source makes a negative allergen or cross-contact claim.

No official allergen matrix, comprehensive ingredient guide, or cross-contact policy was found after all four required searches. Only literal restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked-vendor allergen-positive ingredients are preserved; every other item is explicitly unavailable.

proposedChanges: Replace the 63-row smeared baseline with the 32-product consolidated union of current food and non-alcoholic products from the live restaurant PDFs and linked Toast storefront.
Remove alcohol-only products, PDF category headings, and modifier artifacts from the in-scope application catalog; retain alcohol sections only as explicit out-of-scope surfaces.
Remove stale CK Clams Casino Flatbread, add the current food and non-alcoholic products, and consolidate repeated PDF/Toast presentations without losing source references.

Publish only direct literal allergen positives from restaurant-issued or linked-vendor descriptions; mark all other products unavailable because no current official allergen matrix or cross-contact guide exists.
